name: Upscale a video
markdown:
# Upscale a video

> From the author's earlier studio, cleaned for publication: private paths, ports and some lines were removed, so a step may read short and a screen it names may not exist here. Status in this studio: Tested on the author's old stack.


## Which one
| Method chip | Model | Look | Time | VRAM |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `quality` (default) | SeedVR2 7B sharp fp8, core nodes, 1 step, LAB colour | best detail on faces / knit / hair; most stable on fast motion (flicker 1.54x bicubic on the skate clip) | 67-114 s | 17-20 GB |
| `fast` | RealESRGAN x2 on every frame | most faithful (best PSNR / SSIM vs the true frames) but smoother / plastic | 14-28 s | 2-9 GB |

FlashVSR is **not offered**: its `tiny` mode wrote long runs of black frames (28-68 of 81-97) on every test clip.

## In the studio
1. On any finished video card: **⤢ Upscale 2×** (quality) or **⤢ 2× fast**. A new card appears.
2. Or Video tab → "Upscale video 2x", drop the clip in `source_video`, pick the method chip. No prompt.

## Limits (the tested envelope)
- At most **97 frames** and **480x832 pixels per frame** (the largest test clip, upscaled to 960x1664). A larger clip is
  refused with the reason: its VRAM peak is unmeasured. Studio Wan clips (480x832 x81) fit; H3 clips (1344x768) do not.
- The output keeps the source's frame rate. The graphs drop audio (as tested); the source's audio track is copied back
  onto the result with ffmpeg (video stream copied) [inference].

## Settings (pinned in the graphs)
| Setting | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| quality | LoadVideo → lanczos x2 → SeedVR2Preprocess → VAEEncodeTiled 512/128 (temporal 64/8) → TemporalChunk auto → KSampler 1 step euler simple CFG 1 seed 7 → TemporalMerge → VAEDecodeTiled → SeedVR2PostProcessing LAB → CreateVideo | [tested] ut_vsr_sv7core_* = `workflows/generated/seedvr2_rife_finish_api.json` (pp `Comfy.finish` default) minus RIFE |
| fast | LoadVideo → GetVideoComponents → RealESRGAN_x2plus → ImageUpscaleWithModel → CreateVideo | [tested] ut_vsr_esrgan_* (the studio's image upscaler per frame) |
| Licences | SeedVR2 Apache-2.0; Real-ESRGAN BSD-3-Clause | [documented] ByteDance-Seed/SeedVR, xinntao/Real-ESRGAN |

## Guards
The result is a video: the output guard checks its frames like any studio video.

## Evidence
- Tool smoke 2026-10-11 on  a local port (direct call, vram claim held): `fast` on `untested_vsr_wanroof.mp4` (512x768 x81) →
  1024x1536 x81 in 14.2 s, no audio track (the source has none). `quality` was not re-run (the test rows are its evidence).
- Manifest `a local folder` rows `ut_vsr_{sv7core,esrgan}_*`; results
  `results_par_untested_20261011_plocal.jsonl`; metrics `a local folder`
  (`vsr`), sheets `vsr_*.jpg`.
- Inputs: H3 1344x768 clips downscaled to 672x384 x97 (ground truth = the original frames), Wan 480x832 x81, 512x768 x81.

## 2x/4K A/B and 4K profiles (2026-10-16/17)

> Status: **partly run, then stopped by the author (2026-10-17)**. Code: the earlier studio's video_upscale_ab.py + `scripts/video_upscale_ab.py`
> (resumable, `results.jsonl`, outputs in `a local folder`), graphs `vsr_h3_*`, `vsr_mmh3_*`,
> `vsr_flashvsr_v11`, `vsr_seedvr2_numz_4k`, `vsr_esrgan_chain4k`. Full write-up: KB `VIDEO_UPSCALER_AB_2026-10-16.md`. Tests:
> `tests/tools/test_video_upscale_{ab,4k}.py` (fakes only). Nothing was committed by this work.

### The four methods the author asked about, plus Kandinsky VSR
| Method | What it is (source) | Status on this box |
|---|---|---|
| H3 LatentUpscaler "H10" (`ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3_LatentUpscaler`, TripleHeadedMonkey, no licence file) | Not a video upscaler: a 2x upscale of an H3 *latent* between two H3 samplers + CONST re-noise (README). The headline `learned model` method imports its architecture from `ComfyUI-H3-Latent-Upscaler-Mamad8`, which is **not installed** (checkpoint `h3_clean_latent_upscaler_film_epoch200` is on disk). Interpolation methods (nearest-exact ...) work. | nodes registered on  a local port- a local port; interpolation graph ran. On a decoded video it needs VAE-encode + the whole H3 model (TE 15.7 GB + DiT 12.5 GB). Result: it **rewrites the clip** (face / necklace changed; PSNR 20.3, SSIM 0.54 at denoise 0.35, 21.2 / 0.54 at 0.2). Not an upscaler for finished video. |
| H3 X2 Detail VAE (`MiniMax-H3-X2-Detail-v1.safetensors`, speach1sdef178 on HF, licence unverified; card calls itself a failed-HQ-VAE experiment that became a 2-in-1) | Mode 1: a 2x video VAE (decoder emits 12 packed channels, PixelShuffle x2) decoded by `MiniMaxH3VAEDecodeFast`; mode 2: a reference-image detail path (`ComfyUI-H3-X2-Detailed.zip`, needs the RGB reference, not a latent-only enhancer; the zip is not on the box). | **Blocked**: `VAELoader` fails on  a local port (`decoder.proj_out` 12288x2048 in the file, 3072x2048 in the live core `ComfyUI-v0.39.3`, which builds `MiniMaxH3VideoVAE(out_ch=3)`; the v0.41.2 flux3 tree is the same). Missing: a core that sizes the decoder from the checkpoint. Reproduced 4x, `results.jsonl`. |
| MMH3-UltimateUpscale (`Comfyui-MMH3-UltimateUpscale`, bbaudio-2025, MIT, year-suffixed username, code read) | Re-samples an H3 AV latent with temporal chunks + spatial tiles; its own `upscale_an_existing_video.json` = RealESRGAN x2 in pixel space, VAE-encode, H3 re-sample (1 step, denoise 0.2, sa_solver). Also takes the learned 3D latent upscaler (`minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16`, on disk) to any 32-multiple size. | Registered; both variants ran (face_half). Faithful but soft: PSNR 27.4-27.7, SSIM 0.81, sharpness 46-64 (quality 119, fast 93), flicker x1.2-1.4. 17-25 s. **4K target arms (3840x2176 tiles) never ran.** |
| FlashVSR v1.1 (live `minimax-h3-audio-T8` v1.97.0 nodes) | One-step streaming VSR; the pack README lists `spas_sage_attn` (installed), 2x is "the conservative experimental route" (official validation is 4x). | **Blocked on  a local port**: the live loader (`flashvsr_advanced.py:_required_files`) wants `LQ_proj_in.ckpt`, `TCDecoder.ckpt`, `posi_prompt.pth` in `models/FlashVSR-v1.1`; the box has converted `.safetensors` that only the patched sidecar clone reads. Not submitted (inference from code). Earlier (2026-10-11, sidecar): black frames. |
| Kandinsky 6 VSR 2-step | Official tiled VSR, `kandy-sr` CLI, KVAE -> latent upscaler -> DiT -> KVAE (README in the KB `manifests/`). | **Missing**: weights `diffusion_models/Kandinsky-6.0-VSR-distilled2steps-5s-Diffusers` and `a local folder` are not on disk although dlq 952 logged DONE. Not tested. |

| clip | arm | s | port GiB | PSNR | SSIM | flicker x bicubic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| h3face_half | bicubic / fast / quality | - / 10 / 49 | - / 2.1 / 17.0 | 38.11 / 33.25 / 32.24 | .961 / .921 / .897 | 1.0 / 1.59 / 1.85 |
| h3skate_half | bicubic / fast / quality | - / 9 / 39 | - / 2.1 / 17.0 | 31.81 / 27.94 / 26.04 | .915 / .863 / .824 | 1.0 / 1.82 / 1.50 |
| wananim | fast / quality | 10 / 48 | 2.4 / 18.7 | - | - | 1.36 / 1.43 |
| h3_potter 1344x768 x124 | fast / quality | 39 / **failed** | 3.5 / >79.8 (interrupted at the 4 GiB floor) | - | - | 1.30 / - |
The old KB numbers (97-frame clips) reproduce within noise. Peaks are the ComfyUI process total; after earlier H3 runs the port holds
cached models, so later rows read high (`base_gib` is recorded from the second batch on).

### 4K (3840x2160 landscape / 2160x3840 vertical)
How: the method's native 2x pass, then cover-scale (lanczos) + centre crop to exact UHD, H.264 CRF 18, audio copied, fps kept.
H3 1344x768 -> 2688x1536 -> 3840x2194 -> crop 34 rows (**1.55% of the height**, no padding, no stretch); H3 768x1344 the same on width;
Wan 480x832 -> 960x1664 -> 2215x3840 -> crop 55 columns (2.5%). A 2x of an H3 clip is **not** 4K; the extra x1.43 is interpolated.
56-frame clips (2.33 s), `s/out-s` = seconds per output second; HF = fine-texture energy, slope = spectral slope (my numpy proxies, `scripts/realism_ab.py` is the other agent's).
| clip | route | s | s/out-s | HF | flicker x | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| k_land (H3 1344x768) | bicubic 4K | 6 | - | .512 | 1.0 | reference |
| | RealESRGAN x2 + lanczos (`fourk_fast`) | 22 | 9.4 | .575 | 1.18 | <= 3.5 GiB |
| | same, scale inside the graph (`k4_esr_x2`) | 36 | 15.4 | .601 | 1.28 | agrees with the row above |
| | RealESRGAN x2 twice then UHD (`chain_fast`) | 107 | 45.7 | .582 | 1.29 | no gain over one pass |
| | 4x-UltraSharpV2 (DAT2) then UHD (`k4_esr_us2`) | **785** | **336** | .670 | 1.41 | 6.1 GiB; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 |
| | SeedVR2 7B quality 2x + lanczos (`fourk_quality`) | 104 | 44.5 | **.771** | 1.82 | 39.5 GiB port total |
| k_land_half (GT) | PSNR / SSIM: bicubic 38.32/.963, fast 34.23/.936, esr_x2 33.13/.929, chain 31.00/.918, quality 31.76/.912, us2 34.21/.943 | us2 187 s | | | | |
| k_vert (H3 768x1344) | fast / esr_x2 / chain / quality | 23 / 33 / 116 / 105 | 10 / 14 / 50 / 45 | .320 / .380 / .330 / .386 | 1.09 / 1.29 / 1.17 / 1.33 | quality 39.5 GiB |
| k_vert_half (GT) | PSNR / SSIM: bicubic 41.02/.976, fast 38.15/.963, esr_x2 36.97/.959, chain 34.65/.944, quality 35.87/.950 | | | | | |
| k_wan (480x832) | fast / esr_x2 / chain / quality | 8 / 25 / 70 / 63 | 3.6 / 10.5 / 30 / 27 | .346 / .420 / .463 / .386 | 1.28 / 1.51 / 1.72 / 1.42 | quality 32.8 GiB port total |
No arm produced a black frame (0 on every row). PSNR/SSIM rank bicubic first, as in 2x: they reward blur; use them for faithfulness only.
100% crops (`sheets4k/`): SeedVR2 shows the most real-looking skin cracks, clay and denim stitching; the ESRGAN routes are smoother;
UltraSharpV2 is between. Eyeballed on one clip per orientation; no blind comparison.
File size: H.264 CRF 18 4K = **130-237 MB/min** (video only); H.265 CRF 24 = **38-63 MB/min** (encode ~3 s per 2.3 s). The 18 MB mail
cap holds ~5-8 s of H.264 or ~17-28 s of H.265; Drive's 2 GB holds ~10 min of H.264 or ~35 min of H.265.

### Optimal settings: what research said, what was pinned, what is untested
| Method | Researched recommendation (source) | Pinned in a 4K profile | Tested / untested |
|---|---|---|---|
| SeedVR2 7B core nodes (ByteDance-Seed/SeedVR README; the pp finish graph) | 1 step, CFG 1, LAB colour, tiled VAE; README warns the model over-generates detail on light-degradation 480-720p AIGC input (oversharpened) | `quality` graph unchanged (euler/simple, seed 7, LAB, VAE tiles 512/128, auto temporal chunk) | tested 480x832 x73-97 and 1344x768 x56; x124 at 1344x768 exceeds the card |
| RealESRGAN x2plus | BSD-3; general image model, no sliders | `esrgan_4k`: x2plus, lanczos to UHD | tested all clip types |
| 4x-UltraSharp / V2 (Kim2091; V2 = DAT2) | V2 card: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, general/faces/photo | none | V2 tested on k_land, k_land_half only (785 s / 187 s); V1 never ran |
| MMH3-UltimateUpscale | example: 1 step denoise 0.2 sa_solver turbo LoRA, tiles 864x480 overlap 128, chunk 85 / overlap 17, anchor 0.999 | none | 2x only (face_half); 4K graphs `k4_mmh3_*` never ran |
| H10 / X2 VAE / FlashVSR / Kandinsky VSR | see the table above | none | blocked or missing |

### 4K profiles in the tool (`video_upscale_tools.upscale_video(..., target="4k", profile=None|"auto"|name)`)
Selected automatically from the probed size/orientation when `target="4k"`; recorded as `profile`, `profile_settings`, `profile_evidence` in
the result and part of the cache key. `target=None` is unchanged (a profile is refused there). The default method stays `quality`.
| profile | picks | engine | tested envelope |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wan_4k` | <= 480x832 pixels per frame (also the half-size H3 clips) | SeedVR2 7B quality, 2x, lanczos to UHD | <= 97 frames per run |
| `h3_landscape_4k` | <= 1344x768, landscape | quality, **56-frame pieces** | 1344x768 x56 (39.5 GiB); admission estimate 40 GiB |
| `h3_portrait_4k` | <= 768x1344, portrait | quality, 56-frame pieces | 768x1344 x56 |
| `esrgan_4k` | `method="fast"`, or a frame size over the quality caps | RealESRGAN x2plus, lanczos to UHD | up to 1088x1920 per frame; <= 3.5 GiB |
Evidence for quality over ESRGAN as the 4K default: more fine-texture energy (HF .77 vs .58 on k_land) and visibly more texture in 100% crops;
cost: flicker x1.8 vs x1.2, 44 s per output second vs 9, and 40 GiB. Pieces are upscaled independently: a seam change at a 56-frame cut is
[inference: not measured]. PSNR/SSIM favour ESRGAN/bicubic. If the card is short the tool refuses; `method="fast"` is the fallback.
